result.title: Mitigating Saliency Collapse: Robust Saliency-Aware Long-Text Image-Text Alignment
result.summary: Long-text image-text alignment is essential for fine-grained scene understanding, yet existing methods mainly focus on extending context length or improving local alignment. We identify an overlooked failure mode, saliency collapse, where models over-rely on text that features visual prominence while underutilizing non-salient context. Consequently, retrieval performance degrades sharply when salient content is reduced, despite that the non-salient context remains informative. To address this, we propose RoSA, a saliency-aware finetuning framework that decomposes image-text pairs into complementary salient and contextual views, enabling joint learning of prominent and contextual semantics. We propose a modality-independent decomposition strategy to combine object-level visual saliency estimation with LLM-based text decomposition to bridge vision and language. We employ auxiliary objectives to explicitly align these views, ensuring robust representation with both salient and contextual features. RoSA greatly improves long-text retrieval and demonstrates strong robustness to saliency collapse across benchmarks. Moreover, our auxiliary objectives are plug-and-play, bringing consistent gains to existing tuning methods. Code and checkpoints are available at: https://github.com/intelligolabs/RoSA

AI.brief_summary: 该论文指出长文本图文对齐中的一个被忽视的失败模式「saliency collapse」：模型过度依赖视觉显著的内容而少用仍有信息量的非显著上下文，导致显著线索减少时检索性能骤降；为此提出 RoSA 微调框架，将图文对分解为显著与上下文两个互补视角（对象级视觉显著性估计结合 LLM 文本分解），并用辅助对齐目标联合学习两类语义。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「显著特征压制非显著证据」的诊断与 LVR 关心的视觉细节、任务必要信息能否保留在表示中以及信息坍缩问题相近，双视角分解与辅助目标可供核查是否有助于约束 latent 状态保留上下文证据；但工作面向检索对齐而非推理期状态生成，迁移性需读原文判断。
